description: Converting an object to a map of tuples of any doesn't unify the element types of the tuples
notes: The spec converts an object to a map by converting each attribute to the map's element type (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions), which gives a tuple of a number and a tuple of a string here, and two tuple types of the same length unify element by element (spec.md#type-unification), so the map would hold ["1"] and ["x"], as hashicorp/hcl gives for convert([[1], ["x"]], list(tuple([any]))). go-cty's conversionObjectToMap (cty/convert/conversion_collection.go) unifies the converted attributes only when the map's element type is a collection or object type, not a tuple type, so the two attributes keep different types and the conversion fails. conversionTupleToList always unifies its converted elements (conversionUnifyListElements).
reference_error: attribute types must all match for conversion to map
